text:
maria_sec: Auditor asked for compact evidence pack for RBAC change + KMS decrypts tied to inference-service. Scope: prod, last 30 days, 10 users, raw JSON snippets + mapping to SOC2/ISO controls. Need by EOD.

auditor_jane: Confirm prod only + last 30 days. Raw JSON and MD5 manifest preferred. Two full traces + 8 snippets ok.

tom_infra: I'll export k8s audit diff (rolebinding update) and attach CHG ticket and PR. Example snippet will show verb:update objectRef:rolebindings timestamp.

sam_sre: I'll pull KMS decrypt audit entries and correlate request_id with x-rw-request-id in prod HTTP logs. Splunk query: index=prod_kms action=Decrypt earliest=-30d@d | fields user,keyName,requestId,timestamp | head 200.

olivia_prod: I'll compile 10 sample users and note which two were in the canary on 2025-11-14 (inc:INC-2025-349).

maria_sec: Add the gcloud export of key IAM and rotation schedule. Include approval email (redacted) and a short control-mapping doc (MD). Security-bot please produce bundle + checksums.

security-bot: Automated: evidence bundle created id=bndl-20251116-1, manifest generated, uploaded to s3://redwood-evidence/exports/bndl-20251116-1.zip.

auditor_jane: Received link, will validate checksums and mapping doc and follow up if we need retention proof for GKE audits.

maria_sec: Thanks team, closing after auditor confirms.
